title: Google Drive synced folder
whyItMatters: Drive for desktop keeps streamed and mirrored files on the Mac. A handover should account for both cached copies and account sign-out.
source: Google Drive for desktop on macOS 12.1+ uses ~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-<account> - https://tidbits.com/2023/03/10/apples-file-provider-forces-mac-cloud-storage-changes/
notes: Newer File Provider location; legacy ~/Google Drive and /Volumes/Google Drive mounts are out of scope. Streamed online-only placeholders are counted, not hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Open any file that exists only in the streamed Drive folder and save a copy to a drive you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In the Drive for desktop menu bar icon open the settings and disconnect the account, so it stops syncing this Mac.
steps: Quit Drive for desktop from the menu bar icon.
Remove the Drive for desktop app if you no longer need it on this Mac.
Delete the GoogleDrive folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Cached and mirrored copies leave this Mac. Files stay in the Google account, and online-only files were never downloaded.
cleanup.source: Google, Customize Drive for desktop settings: https://support.google.com/drive/answer/13470231
